evidence: Positive daily and weekly returns coexist with a negative four-hour return and a positive latest hour. Volume is subdued and recent hourly volatility exceeds its weekly counterpart. Two matured exemplars reached the downside barrier first, one reached the upside first, and one reached neither. Their divergent outcomes support a modest downside tilt with substantial uncertainty; the small state-only sample warrants probability smoothing and broad excursion quantiles.
